description: Replace the primary nameservers of a secondary zone (the servers Hetzner transfers the zone from). The ENTIRE zone content will be taken from the new primaries on the next transfer. Only applicable to zones in secondary mode. The first call returns a short-lived confirmation token bound to exactly this nameserver list.

confirm_token.description: Confirmation token from the previous call of this same tool with identical arguments. Omit on the first call — the server then returns a token that is valid for a few minutes.

primary_nameservers.description: Primary nameservers to transfer the zone from (secondary zones)

address.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address of the primary nameserver

tsig_key.description: TSIG key to use for the zone transfer. Treat as a secret — it becomes part of the conversation context.

zone.description: ID or name of the zone, e.g. "example.com"

name: change_primary_nameservers
title: Change primary nameservers
